name: Art Nouveau
visualIdentity: Supplemental reference, not a source-collection named style. Flowing botanical ornament, flowers, long organic curves, integrated figures and lettering, coherent line-weight variation, and natural or limited print color.
suitableUses: Expressive posters, botanical guides, cultural pages, campaign reveals, and illustrated narratives. SVG borders can frame readable HTML text; vines can reveal artwork or connect scenes. Suitability beyond these stated examples is inferred.
limitations: Ornament should not obstruct essential content. Omit door-bloom motion when emergence is meaningless, assets are missing, or overlap conflicts with the style or legibility. Keep chapter transitions only when they support the narrative; avoid spectacle that obscures explanation.
palette: For new work without an approved palette, suggested tokens are warm paper #F3ECD9 (background), #293E32 (foreground), botanical #788659 and terracotta #B67B57 (accents); four discrete colors, no gradient. Suggestions yield to exact task, brand, source, and semantic colors. Preserve roles, color families, limits, and asset colors. Accent pairings listed fail normal-text contrast; use dark foreground on paper and inspect actual compositing.
motionAndInteraction: Reveal botanical strokes along their curves like growing vines; avoid mechanical bounce. Preserve deliberate cuts and reading holds. Video state must follow seekable composition time. Interactive HTML may add reversible hover with focus or tap equivalents, scroll-scrubbed chapter handoffs, or story steps, only when supported by the scene. Keep forward, reverse, direct seeks, reduced-motion and static states coherent; no live input dependency in video.
audio: No fixed soundtrack is specified. Choose music, voice, effects, ambience, or silence for the subject and audience; honor supplied requirements and assets. Keep speech clear, avoid clipping or competing vocals, synchronize to picture, and inspect the final mix.
assetRequirements: Prepare drawable botanical paths and reusable ornamental groups; provide appropriate fonts, copy, and any flower or opening assets required by chosen motion. Keep figures and lettering integrated without blocking reading. Load local assets and fonts, seed randomness, and cache stateful effects. Missing required emergence assets may make that motion unsuitable.
combinations: Style alone suits ornamental artwork. With style-019, use margins and drop caps for ornament, body text #293E32 on #F3ECD9, line-group reveals, and no mechanical slide-ins. With style-030, draw characters in Nouveau contours, use only its four tokens, avoid paper textures, imported yellow, painterly fills, and bouncy motion. These are specified pairings; other compatibility is unspecified.
productionApproach: Choose visual renderer and motion engine by fidelity and scene needs; SVG draws scalable paths and masks, while GSAP DrawSVGPlugin reveals stroke length. HyperFrames handles composition, synchronization, validation, and export; Remotion is fallback only if unavailable or a verified limitation blocks a requirement, with reason recorded. Keep rendering and motion separate from pipeline; drive deterministic, seekable time. For interactive effects, bind hover/scroll progress coherently. Inspect rendered frames, full video, text, timing, dimensions, audio, and loop as applicable.
